message: As the storms roll in, I've found myself reminiscing about the simple joys of hunkering down at home. With a little planning, we can turn a wintery day into a cozy adventure instead of a scramble. I stumbled across some great tips on how to prepare for winter weather, and it got me thinking about rediscovering low-tech fun—like building forts or playing board games by candlelight. What’s your favorite way to make the most of a stormy day? ☔
